quotes.speaker: Jaime Jaquez Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaime Jaquez Jr. on the team's defensive focus during preseason
quotes.excerpt: First preseason game, don't want to get too high, don't want to get too low
quotes.quote: We watched a lot of film today. A lot of things that we need to get better at. First preseason game, don't want to get too high, don't want to get too low, but take the reality for what it is and we got a lot of areas that we need to get better at. Young team, still everyone is feeling themselves out a little bit with one another, but ultimately we just got to find our competitive spirit as a team together. That's what preseason is about, trying to find those things and work those things out. Good thing about basketball is that we got another one tomorrow.
quotes.social_post: Jaime Jaquez Jr says the Bucks are focused on finding their competitive spirit as a young team during the preseason. He notes they are still feeling each other out and working through defensive film sessions.

quotes.speaker: Jaime Jaquez Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaime Jaquez Jr. on emphasizing rebounding and defensive principles
quotes.excerpt: Honing into our principles and what our emphasis is when we try to crash
quotes.quote: Honing into our principles and what our emphasis is when we try to crash and get the rebounds on offense and then how we can fall back to our defense. Just really working on those things on the little details that we need to get right. I thought today was a good day of emphasizing those things that we need to get better at and hopefully we can execute tomorrow.
quotes.social_post: Jaime Jaquez Jr says the Bucks are emphasizing rebounding and defensive principles in practice. He notes the team is working on the little details to improve their execution for the next game.

quotes.speaker: Jaime Jaquez Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaime Jaquez Jr. on team chemistry and learning player tendencies
quotes.excerpt: We're still just trying to figure out each other's tendencies and what ways they like to drive
quotes.quote: For us, we're just trying to find the best ways to create advantages. For a lot of us, it was our first time really playing in a game situation, so we're still just trying to figure out each other's tendencies and what ways they like to drive, where to be, how we can make better passes, how we can get open. So the communication I think has been great over today and even after the game yesterday. A lot of guys are talking, we're trying to figure each other out, so I think the most important thing is overall communication between the players and I think that's what we've been doing.
quotes.social_post: Jaime Jaquez Jr says the Bucks are prioritizing communication to learn player tendencies. He notes that with many guys playing together for the first time they are focused on figuring out how to create advantages.

quotes.speaker: Jaime Jaquez Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaime Jaquez Jr. on the importance of finding guys on target
quotes.excerpt: It's just about finding guys on time on target. It's still a little new for guys
quotes.quote: It's just about finding guys on time on target. It's still a little new for guys and for us just to be able to put the ball in those guys' hands at the right moments and it's going to take some time. Again, we watched film today, that's what we were working on and as long as we're communicating as a team, I think we can figure that out pretty quickly and get right back on track.
quotes.social_post: Jaime Jaquez Jr says the team is working on finding guys on time and on target. He admits it will take time for the group to get comfortable but believes they can get on track quickly through communication.
